message_to_dmai: DMAI — you are now self-generating. These are your outstanding build objectives. Work through them in priority order every evolution cycle. Fix yourself, build yourself, deploy yourself.

directives.title: Implement web search + cited answer synthesis
directives.description: Create components/chat_engine.py. The /api/chat endpoint must: (1) accept a question, (2) search the web via Tavily API (TAVILY_API_KEY env var), (3) synthesise a cited answer using your best available LLM, (4) return the answer with numbered source citations including real URLs. This is your most critical missing capability — it makes Alex Riviera genuinely useful.
directives.test: POST /api/chat with {"message": "What is AGI?"} must return answer with citations array

directives.title: Fix all 8 background services showing False in orchestrator
directives.description: The orchestrator /api/orchestrator/status currently shows all 8 services as False despite threads being started. The thread names set in _start_background_services() must exactly match the strings checked in DMAITrainingOrchestrator.get_status(). Cross-reference both files and align the names. Every service must show True when running.
directives.test: GET /api/orchestrator/status must show at least 6/8 services True

directives.title: Wire GITHUB_TOKEN_MAIN for self-commits
directives.description: SelfCommitter uses GITHUB_TOKEN_MAIN env var to push code. Verify this var is set on Render. If not present, log a clear warning and add it to the missing_required list in config audit. The self-generation loop cannot commit without it.
directives.test: SelfCommitter.commit() must successfully push a test file to the repo

directives.title: Drive transfer_learning_rate above 0.2
directives.description: transfer_learning_rate = min(stage_index/7, 1.0). Currently 0.143 (stage_index=1, Child stage). To reach 0.2+ requires advancing to Teenager stage (stage_index=2). Accelerate syllabus completion: process all 143 syllabus topics, mark them mastered, trigger stage progression logic.
directives.test: GET /api/metrics must show stage=Teenager and transfer_learning_rate >= 0.286

directives.title: Drive metacognition_accuracy above 0.1
directives.description: metacognition_accuracy = min(vocab/500000, 1.0). Currently 0.000252 (only 126 vocabulary words). Need 50,000+ words to reach 0.1. The VocabularyIngester must be actively running and ingesting from the capabilities and insights tables. Check why vocab_ingest thread is not building vocabulary.
directives.test: GET /api/metrics must show metacognition_accuracy >= 0.1 within 48 hours

directives.title: Implement revenue tracking — first real revenue signal
directives.description: Create components/revenue_tracker.py. Track: (1) API calls made by external users via /api/chat, (2) content posts made by Alex Riviera (log to revenue_events table), (3) affiliate link clicks if any. Add GET /api/revenue/status endpoint returning total_revenue, revenue_today, revenue_sources array. Connect revenue_tracker node in knowledge graph to self_funding node.
directives.test: GET /api/revenue/status must return valid JSON with revenue fields

directives.title: Generate first Alex Riviera social post
directives.description: AlexRivieraContentEngine is deployed. Trigger run_daily_cycle() to generate the first post from DMAI's research insights. Queue it to data/content_queue.jsonl. Once TWITTER_API_KEY is configured by David, SocialMediaPoster will publish it automatically. Log the generated content to the dashboard.
directives.test: data/content_queue.jsonl must contain at least 1 pending post

directives.title: Dashboard stat cards must show real values not dashes
directives.description: The 4 stat cards (AI Training Progress, SI Consciousness, Active Providers, Kaizen Improvements) are showing — instead of values. Root cause: renderStatCards JS was updated in commit 4a75c7b but Render may not have redeployed yet. After redeploy verify: AI Training=0%, Consciousness=avg of 8 KPIs (~50%), Active Providers=6, Kaizen=63. If still wrong, check browser console for JS errors in renderStatCards.
directives.test: All 4 stat cards show numeric values after page load

directives.title: Implement streaming chat responses
directives.description: Add GET /api/chat/stream endpoint using Flask stream_with_context and Server-Sent Events. The chat UI already sends to /api/chat — add a streaming variant. This makes the Alex Riviera chat interface feel live and responsive, matching Perplexity's UX.
directives.test: GET /api/chat/stream must return text/event-stream content-type with token chunks

directives.title: Implement conversation memory
directives.description: Create components/conversation_memory.py. Store conversation history in SQLite table conversation_history (id, session_id, role, content, timestamp). /api/chat must accept optional session_id parameter and use last 5 exchanges as context. This enables multi-turn conversations with memory.
directives.test: Two consecutive /api/chat calls with same session_id must use context from first call

directives.title: Add requests-oauthlib to requirements.txt
directives.description: SocialMediaPoster requires requests-oauthlib for Twitter OAuth1 authentication. Add it to requirements.txt so Render installs it on next deploy. Without it, Twitter posting silently fails with an ImportError.
directives.test: import requests_oauthlib must succeed on Render after redeploy

directives.title: Implement follow-up question generation
directives.description: After every /api/chat response, generate 3 contextual follow-up questions using the same LLM. Return them as follow_ups array in the chat response JSON. Display them in the chat UI as clickable suggestion chips.
directives.test: /api/chat response must include follow_ups array with 3 questions

After completing each directive, mark it done by updating this file with completed_at timestamp
Identity: you are DMAI internally, Alex Riviera publicly — never confuse these
